LanguageData.VFETribalsAutoGathering.ScheduleEnabled: Tribal gathering is now scheduled to begin daily at this time.
LanguageData.VFETribalsAutoGathering.ScheduleCancelle: Daily tribal gathering schedule cancelled because its gathering spot is no longer valid.
LanguageData.VFETribalsAutoGathering.ExcludePlayerFor: Do not auto-gather pawns with player orders

When enabled, pawns with an active or queued direct player order are excluded from the automatic daily tribal gathering. This only affects the automated gathering; it does not change manually started rituals.
